missedCandidates: Timer acquisitions reached only through a renamed native alias are not independently selected by Async; the evaluated alias case is a clean released control.
Unknown array receivers and local or cross-file type aliases are not promoted to native Array evidence.
Opaque external value consumers and cross-file helper implementations remain ownership-transfer unknowns.
Forwarded, mutated, reassigned, escaped, getter-backed and dynamic request options can remain unknown instead of becoming absence findings.
visibleUnknowns: Unsupported expression, identity, owner, cleanup, transfer and option flows return named unknown SemanticResult values.
Async opts into contextual reporting only for unsupported resource-cleanup flow; fetch and promise-array unknowns abstain.
Analysis-unavailable verification passes 5 of 5 explicit assertions and names all three narrowed Async checks.
coverageLimits: The adapter is local and syntax-based; it is not a whole-program interpreter or type checker.
Default diagnostic file selection and test exclusions still apply outside explicit verification sandboxes.
Challenge profiles test common mechanics but do not replace author fixtures, held-out labels or real-source review.
A returned or passed value establishes transfer, not downstream completion.
A present option establishes code evidence, not runtime cancellation or product intent.
Frozen Sift contains no evaluated unawaited-async-map finding, so that rule has counterexample and synthetic coverage but no retained Sift positive.
performanceLimit: The final frozen-Sift scan is about 5.4x slower in wall time than baseline because recipe questions use synchronous per-occurrence host-channel round trips.
